subject: Mutual action timeline and onboarding playline — GPU pool sizing & procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: James Lee <james.lee@helium.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@helium.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here asked me to put together the high-level timelines we discussed so they can sync with our Sourcing team. Two constraints to flag up front:

- Helium’s security checklist requires dedicated clusters to be provisioned inside our VPC (private deployment) — 10–12 week lead time for on-prem or cross-connect approvals.
- Hardware time-to-delivery: depending on SKUs we may be looking at shipment windows of 6–10 weeks after order confirmation.

Can Redwood share a mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to procurement triggers (PO issuance, SOC2 evidence handoff) and GPU pool sizing guidance? If you can include contingency checkpoints (e.g., staggered tranches) that will help us prioritize minimal viable capacity for go-live.

Attaching a quick spreadsheet with our expected traffic profile (very rough). Thanks — happy to jump on a call this week.

Attachments: Helium_traffic_profile_v1.csv (attachment stub)

Best,
James
Senior Product, Helium AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@helium.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

James —

Appreciate the heads-up and the profile. I pulled the team together and sketched a "playline" that ties your evaluation gates to procurement/ops checkpoints; this is intentionally pragmatic so your Sourcing and infra teams can align on decision points. Key assumptions up front:

- Initial pilot: 4xA100-equivalent GPUs (quantized models, burst capacity disabled) to support 1M tokens/day.
- Production baseline: 16xA100-equivalent (or equivalent h100/quantized mix) for 8–10M tokens/day.
- Private deployment on VPC + cross-connect expected lead: 8–12 weeks for network & security approvals; hardware lead-time 6–8 weeks after PO.

I've attached a draft MAP (Helium-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a simple GPU sizing CSV (gpu_sizing_model_v3.csv). The MAP has milestones, required deliverables, and who owns the procurement triggers. Please review and tell me which items you want moved earlier/later.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) A short gating call this Thurs (30 min) to agree milestones and acceptance criteria.
2) You confirm internal Sourcing lead and their PO cadence.
3) Redwood provides SOC2 artifacts and a dedicated deployment checklist by EOW after the call.

If agreed, we can convert the MAP to a shared Google Sheet and add dates after your internal approvals.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helium-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (attachment stub); gpu_sizing_model_v3.csv (attachment stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

Quick internal note —

I flagged the private deployment lead times with Platform. Two operational notes to put into the MAP before sharing it back:

- We should surface an explicit fallback to hosted Dedicated for the first 4–6 weeks post-PO (regional routing + token accounting) so Helium can start traffic while racks are in transit.
- Add an acceptance check for KV-cache warmup and throughput testing once the first GPU tranche is live — run a 48-hour soak test.

I'll add these rows to the MAP and annotate responsibilities (Redwood ops / Helium infra).

—Ben
Head of Customer Solutions

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@helium.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

Thanks Marissa — good start. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/security: 

1) Can Redwood commit to a list of SOC2 artifacts and a sample audit log export format before we sign PO? Our security team needs to validate retention windows and field-level redaction.
2) For the contingency path: if hardware lead-times extend beyond 10 weeks, would Redwood support a short-term Dedicated hosted burst (metered) until our private racks are in place? We will need cost estimates for that bridge.

Also, can you call out the exact GPU SKUs you recommend for the pilot vs baseline? Our hardware team wants to align on power & rack density constraints.

Happy to take the call on Thursday — Aisha (cc'd) will bring in procurement.

Regards,
James

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@helium.ai>, James Lee <james.lee@helium.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

Aisha / James —

Thanks — answered inline below and updated the MAP accordingly. High-level responses: 

- SOC2/artifacts: we will provide the SOC2 Type II report, a control matrix, and an example audit-log export (CSV with timestamps + token-level deltas) by EOD Friday after our call. Responsibility: Redwood Compliance (Mina) to own artifacts.
- Hosted Dedicated bridge: yes, we can provide a metered dedicated-hosted bridge for up to 8 weeks. I'll include cost bands in the MAP (low/medium/high traffic) and put the finance owner on the line.
- GPU SKUs: Pilot recommendation = 4xH100-80GB (or 8xA100-40GB quantized config). Baseline recommendation = 16xH100-80GB equivalent (mix allowed). I'll add density and power notes to the hardware appendix in the MAP.

Open items for the Thursday gating call:
- Helium to confirm Sourcing lead and internal PO decision window (target 2 weeks).
- Helium to validate the pilot acceptance criteria (latency P50/P95 targets, throughput target, and 48-hour soak).
- Redwood to confirm dates for SOC2 artifact delivery and Hosted bridge pricing.

I'll share a refreshed MAP link after the call. Proposed call: Thu 24 Jun 15:00 PT — 30 min. Let me know if that works.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Helium-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (updated), gpu_sizing_model_v3.csv (updated)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@helium.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, James Lee <james.lee@helium.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement constraints and rough timelines

Marissa —

Call confirmed for Thu 24 Jun 15:00 PT (we had to shift internally; thanks for being flexible). We've reviewed the updated MAP and the checklist looks good. A few final notes before the call: 

- Procurement will aim to issue a conditional PO within 10 business days pending SOC2 artifact review. If something in the artifact set requires escalation, procurement will escalate to Sourcing for a final sign-off (we'll share the contact on the call).
- We accept the pilot SKU recommendation as a starting point — we'll ask our hardware team to confirm rack density constraints before the call.
- Please include an explicit acceptance line in the MAP that defines "Go/No-Go" for tranche 2 (production baseline) — we want a clear set of objective metrics.

Thanks, looking forward to the call.

--
Aisha Rahman
Head of Procurement, Helium AI

Referenced attachments: Helium-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (updated), gpu_sizing_model_v3.csv
